paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates a "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Generation Length Comparison" across four distinct categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered from left to right as GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, without an explicit axis label or strictly sorted order. The vertical value axis represents "Generation Length (words)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to just above 8000, with numeric tick labels and horizontal dashed gridlines at regular intervals of 1000. The chart displays grouped vertical bars positioned side-by-side for each category, which are distinguished by color according to a top legend: light pink bars represent "Vanilla CoT," and dark red bars represent "TLDR (Ours)." Within each group, the light pink bar appears on the left and features an exact numeric value annotated in black text above it, while the dark red bar appears on the right and is annotated with a red percentage indicating a relative difference. For GSM8K, the light pink bar has a value of 554, and the adjacent dark red bar is the shortest in the chart, annotated with "-54%". For MATH500, the light pink bar is 2861, and the dark red bar is annotated "-46%". The AIME category features the tallest bar overall, with the light pink bar at 6820 and the dark red bar annotated "-7%". Finally, for AMC, the light pink bar is marked at 4510, and the corresponding dark red bar is annotated "-25%".
model_annotations.German: The grouped vertical bar chart, titled "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Generation Length Comparison," illustrates generation lengths for two distinct methods across four benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis represents the benchmark categories, ordered from left to right as GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, without an explicit axis label. The vertical value axis is labeled "Generation Length (words)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to over 8000, with numeric tick labels provided at regular intervals of 1000, accompanied by light gray dashed horizontal gridlines. The data is organized into side-by-side paired bars for each category. According to the top-center legend, light pink bars represent "Vanilla CoT," positioned on the left of each pair, while dark red bars represent "TLDR (Ours)," positioned on the right. The exact generation lengths for the Vanilla CoT method are explicitly annotated in black text above each light pink bar: 554 for GSM8K (representing the shortest group), 2861 for MATH500, 6820 for AIME (representing the tallest group), and 4510 for AMC. The TLDR (Ours) dark red bars are consistently shorter than their corresponding Vanilla CoT bars in every category. Above each dark red bar, a red text annotation indicates a percentage: "-54%" for GSM8K, "-46%" for MATH500, "-7%" for AIME, and "-25%" for AMC. The categories are not sorted in a strictly alphabetical or numerical order, and visual emphasis is primarily applied through the explicitly labeled data points and red percentage text annotating the bars.
